# cmp

Compare two inputs byte by byte through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/cmp first.bin second.bin

moonx cli/cmp -s first.bin second.bin

moonx cli/cmp -n 16 first.bin second.bin
```

Report the first difference by default. Exit 0 for equal input, 1 for differences and 2 for errors.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-s`, `--silent` | Report status only; stop at the first difference. |
| `--quiet` | Report status only; stop at the first difference. |
| `-l`, `--verbose` | List every differing byte. |
| `-b`, `--print-bytes` | Show differing byte values. |
| `-n VALUE`, `--bytes VALUE` | Compare at most LIMIT bytes. |
| `-i VALUE`, `--ignore-initial VALUE` | Skip initial bytes independently. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Notes

- -s suppresses diagnostics; -l lists differing bytes. Skip offsets and comparison limits are byte counts.

Build from source with the MoonBit 1.0 RC1 toolchain.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
